verdict.rationale: Formant documents event-triggered webhooks that call any HTTP endpoint when a Formant event fires (formant-docs-28). It also claims anomaly alerting (formant-docs-5) and automated incident-response workflows (formant-docs-18), which together cover the core idea of a rule triggering an action on an event. Missing for 10: detail on how rule conditions are defined, evidence of native in-platform actions such as auto-dispatching commands beyond webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
